_methodology: Every record's end_time is the receipt file's own filesystem mtime (verifiable: `stat -c %Y <file>`). start_time is the end_time of the PREVIOUS record in the same sequential group (these commands ran one after another in a single session, never concurrently, within a group), except where the tool's own output reports an exact elapsed duration (bun test's '[X.XXs]' summary line), which is used instead and noted in internal_duration. No wall-clock start time was captured independently at run time for the non-timed tools (typecheck, lint, boundaries, gate-integrity, the two coverage-gate scripts); the sequential-mtime estimate is a lower/upper bound, not an independent measurement. Every exit_code was read from the command's own $? immediately after each run in this session; where non-zero, exit_note explains why and cites where the finding is disclosed.
